item.title: NSW Ambulance app marks lifesaving milestone - Inside State Government
item.description: NSW Ambulance is celebrating a major milestone, with 100 lives saved through its GoodSAM community program, which works by alerting registered volunteers when a suspected cardiac arrest is reported to Triple Zero (000). Responders can choose whether to accept the alert and provide cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), while an ambulance is dispatched at the same time. […]

item.description: Enhancements to Western Australia’s practical driving assessments (PDAs) system begin today, 1 April, making the booking system more efficient, flexible and easier for prospective drivers.
